name: Osang Healthcare Co.,Ltd
summary: Osang Healthcare Co.,Ltd, based in Anyang, South Korea, is a company focused on the innovation, advancement, and global commercialization of diverse diagnostic biosensing solutions. Their comprehensive product offerings include tests for key health markers such as blood glucose, hemoglobin A1c, and cholesterol, in addition to sophisticated immuno- and molecular diagnostic technologies. These cutting-edge products reach approximately 110 nations across the globe. Established in 1996, the firm operated as Infopia Co., Ltd. until its rebranding to Osang Healthcare Co.,Ltd in April 2017.
